purpose: Name the remaining late actor-template records with complete level-exit and interaction-table consumers.

templates.name: ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_74_LEVEL06_EXIT
templates.post_initialize: On a free reverse slot, initializes facing byte 0xFF and position (0x00A0,0x01C0), then arms the exit transition flags.

templates.name: ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_84_INTERACTION_FD_FE
templates.post_initialize: The 0x001B6896 consumer adds (+0x14,-1) to the spawned position; the 0x001B68B0 consumer adds (+0x0B,+6).

conclusion: Both records are exact 20-byte templates selected by complete static consumers. The Level 06 exit record is isolated by the level callback table, while the type-0x84 record is shared by the 0xFD/0xFE interaction handlers; adjacent late records without equally bounded consumers remain unresolved.
